notes: This minor release adds two native packs and moves fourteen others to new minor versions; it is built by the released Bifrost 0.15.1 producer and needs Bifrost 0.15.1 or later to read. New: bifrost.go.stdlib.encoding-gob-declarations and bifrost.go.stdlib.encoding-gob (BSD-3-Clause, from Go's encoding/gob), whose summaries cover NewDecoder, NewEncoder, Encoder.Encode, Encoder.EncodeValue, Register and RegisterName. Decoder.Decode and Decoder.DecodeValue have no summary, because the semantic-model schema cannot express their write into the argument (bifrost-dev#9907); calls to them stay unresolved rather than proven clean. Changed: bifrost.go.stdlib.net 2.1.0 adds net.Conn and net.Listener interface summaries that cover every implementation, so Close and Accept calls bind with complete coverage. The thirteen Go declaration packs (concurrency, bytes, crypto/x509, encoding/pem, errors, log, net, net/http, net/url, os and sync/atomic at 2.1.0, and the testify assert and require packs at 1.1.0) mark every declared function and method callable_family_complete, which Bifrost needs before a resolved-call can bind exactly; their fields, identities and completeness are otherwise unchanged. The generator moves from the released bifrost-semantic-pack 0.15.0 to the released, checksum-pinned 0.15.1 binary from the v0.15.1 release of public commit 04fdd17d2606d13a7a5f13b012bfbe3ad9729d1e (executable SHA-256 7322cdbd653830aaba349c9a278eceb97573965739b2845412a3074080b6acc2). Its bifrost.external.java production uses semantic-model schema 22 instead of 21, so this release tightens what a consumer must read: use Bifrost 0.15.1 or later. The bundle keeps release index schema 4 and lists 64 packs. All other jobs and recipes are unchanged from 0.9.0. Rules 0.9.1 keeps its exact dependency on packs 0.9.0; rules 0.10.0 moves it here. Generation, integrity, compatibility and per-run completeness remain separate from behavior qualification.
